Genesis — Instructions and Commands

Instructions · All Old Testament books · Original Torah and New Testament index

171 additional passage records · 190 quoted verse units. Read Genesis in Saints Translation.

This is a working instruction register organized by topic and then classification. Open a passage for its exact wording, source link and context note. Historical orders and rhetorical or poetic addresses retain their original setting; their presence here does not make them universal laws.

Read this supplement together with the existing Torah requirements. Its narrower original count is preserved. 37 selected verse units already represented by that index are cross-referenced below instead of re-entered. Other thematic overlap still requires review.

Review status: Working catalogue: the source collection covers every Old Testament book currently in Saints.Bible. Individual commands, repeated formulations, speakers and Christian application still require further review; this is not a certified exhaustive count of laws.

Topics: Faith, repentance and allegiance · Worship, prayer and holy things · Justice, truth and protection · Mercy, neighbors and the vulnerable · Family, marriage and household · Wisdom, speech and conduct · Work, possessions and stewardship · Historical commissions, journeys and public life
